description: Defines the payload to configure the field scheme for a project. See [Field schemes](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-field-schemes/#api-group-field-schemes).

description.description: The description of the field scheme

items.description: The field association items for this field scheme.

name.description: The name of the field scheme

onConflict.description: The strategy to use when there is a conflict with an existing field scheme. FAIL - Fail execution, this always needs to be unique; USE - Use the existing entity and ignore new entity parameters
